features.profile_configuration: bounded active-profile language configuration foundation implemented
features.rtl_ltr_context: HTML attributes and stable body classes implemented
features.directory_routing: directory-style storefront routing and safe current-path language URLs implemented
features.wordpress_locale_switching: public locale filters and switch_to_locale bridge implemented for storefront requests
features.language_switcher: accessible style-neutral shortcode/public filter surface implemented
features.translation_repository: versioned entry/revision tables with published lookup and source hashes implemented
features.translation_workflow: append-only draft/review/published workflow with published-revision isolation implemented

notes: WordPress minimum/tested ranges will be finalized with the Phase 0 environment audit and compatibility matrix.
Language directories are resolved before normal WordPress route parsing so WordPress and WooCommerce remain authoritative for the internal storefront route.
Unprefixed storefront routes remain valid and use the configured default language context; canonical redirect policy is deferred to the SEO slice.
Language-switcher URLs preserve same-origin storefront paths and non-action query state while dropping nonce/action parameters.
Translation storage is module-owned and versioned independently from the Theme and customer profile configuration.
Published revisions remain customer-facing while newer draft/review revisions are edited; publishing archives only the previous published revision.
Translation lookup falls back to the configured fallback language and then the caller-provided source string.
Customer-specific language lists live in the versioned customer profile rather than generic package code.
WooCommerce commercial data ownership is unchanged.
